accessibilityInspection.reason: The installed main app was not running. Launching it would refresh real EventKit and XPC state, which this read-only baseline run was forbidden to mutate.

policy.rule: A positive end-user scenario requires current packaged UI proof plus the relevant durable or external effect. Source and unit tests alone are insufficient. Negative deferred-scope invariants may be retained when source, package shape, and framework searches prove the capability is absent.
